name: Live region
summary: The screen-reader announcement region — aria-live assertive + atomic, always mounted (even empty), never role=alert.
highlights: aria-live assertive and atomic, always mounted
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-live-region> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Mount it once and KEEP it mounted: a live region that appears together with its text is often not announced, because assistive tech was not yet watching it. It is aria-live="assertive" + aria-atomic="true" by default (politeness="polite" for non-urgent updates) and deliberately carries NO role="alert", which would announce the text twice. Drive it with the `message` attribute, or call announce(text) — it clears, then writes on the next tick, so the same message announced twice is heard twice. Visually hidden unless `visible` is set.
codeNote: Same element in every framework. Keep ONE instance mounted near the app root and announce through it; do not render a fresh region per message.

spec.label: Lifecycle
spec.value: stays in the DOM when empty so AT is already tracking it

spec.label: Hidden (default)
spec.value: visually hidden 1×1 clip — read by AT, not seen

spec.label: Re-announce
spec.value: announce(text) clears then writes after 50ms → a repeat is heard again

props.name: message
props.desc: Text to announce; changing it announces the new text

props.name: politeness
props.desc: polite waits for the screen reader to finish; assertive interrupts

props.name: visible
props.desc: Show the text as a secondary status line instead of hiding it

props.name: clear()
props.desc: Empty the region without removing it

whenToUse.when: something changed that a sighted user sees but a screen-reader user would miss (saved, results updated, timer ended)
the change is a validation error on one field
a visible transient confirmation — it carries its own live semantics

opinion.note: Never an ad-hoc <div aria-live> rendered only while there is a message — it unmounts empty and misses the announcement. Assertive interrupts the user: use it for time-critical news, polite for the rest. Replaces the aha-design plugin's aha-design-shared-components registry entry (SHARED-03).
opinion.dsv3: No DS V3 frame — a non-visual a11y primitive. The optional visible line uses the token layer (text-secondary, 14/22).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

selfCheck.label: aria-live assertive + aria-atomic true, no role=alert

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] is the default hidden, EMPTY region (proves it stays mounted empty); the [visible] sibling proves the visible status line.
